content: Resolved. Six of the seven Slice A down() methods were executed and observed succeeding in the reported output; the seventh (player_guardians) was reversed separately once it had been applied to the development database. The defect the review found is fixed too: the drop-name migration restores its column as nullable rather than backfilling empty strings. A clean rebuild with seed data followed and produced the expected scenario, including the two-guardian child.
